data.long_meaning: Originating from the Arabic language, Mehry is a name given to a lady or a noblewoman. It is a beautiful name with a rich meaning, rooted in the Arabic language and Islamic culture. The name Mehry carries the meaning “Lady, noblewoman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mehry usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, noblewoman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
